itens.titulo: AN ADDRESS BY PRESIDENT BOLA AHMED TINUBU, GCFR, AT THE CLOSING CEREMONY OF THE 2026 NATIONAL YOUTH CONFERENCE (YOUTH CONFAB), ABUJA, MONDAY, 9 NOVEMBER 2026. THE SPEECH WAS DELIVERED BY SPEAKER OF THE HOUSE OF REPRESENTATIVES, TAJUDEEN ABBAS
itens.resumo: PROTOCOL My dear young Nigerians, Today, I stand before you with a renewed sense of hope and confidence in the future of our great nation. Over the past few days, you have gathered from different parts of Nigeria, and from beyond our shores, to discuss the future of our country. I have followed the proceedings […]
itens.titulo_pt: Um discurso do presidente bola ahmed tinubu, gcfr, na cerimônia de encerramento da conferência nacional da juventude de 2026 (confab jovens), abuja, segunda-feira, 9 de novembro de 2026. o discurso foi proferido pelo orador da casa de representantes, tajudeen abás
itens.resumo_pt: PROTOCOLO Meus queridos jovens nigerianos, Hoje estou diante de vós com um renovado sentido de esperança e confiança no futuro da nossa grande nação. Nos últimos dias, vocês reuniram-se de diferentes partes da Nigéria, e de além das nossas costas, para discutir o futuro do nosso país.

itens.resumo: “I was profoundly saddened to learn of the passing of Chief Unanawao Eteyen Amba, popularly known as Utrikang Oro, a respected party stalwart and former Deputy National Secretary of the defunct Action Congress of Nigeria. “I extend my heartfelt condolences to the bereaved family, political associates, friends and the people of Oro over the loss […]
